# A Personal Brand Is Not an Institution — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-81112
Voiceover: The house is visible as both maker attribution and an enduring cataloguing unit.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Mrs. Philip K. Rhinelander, 1946

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — B10-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · SIGNAL — What does the public recognize?. Identify the repeated promise, visual language, subject, and point of view that make the person legible. These signals matter, but they are evidence of recognition—not proof that the work can be produced, governed, or continued.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B10-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · SYSTEM — What repeats without performance?. Map how research becomes a brief, how decisions are approved, how work is produced, and how quality is reviewed. A system must be inspectable enough to improve and flexible enough to accommodate judgment.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B10-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · ASSET — What remains under accountable control?. Separate reputation from the name, entity, marks, domains, mailing list, contracts, files, samples, and archive. The public may perceive one identity while ownership and access are fragmented across many records.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B10-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · ABSENCE — What happens when the founder is offline?. Run a seventy-two-hour absence test. Can collaborators find current files, communicate with clients, fulfill obligations, protect accounts, and identify who may decide? The gaps reveal where a brand still depends on continuous personal availability.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
